info.brief: Functions for interacting with the Xoshiro256 native extension
info.description: Functions for interacting with the Xoshiro256 native extension

elements.name: xoshiro256.seed
elements.description: Create state for the pseudo-random generator: equal seeds produce equal sequences of numbers. Accepts a number or a string (decimal representation of uint64, max 20 digits in the string) if full 64-bit precision required. State is seeded using splitmix64 algorithm.

elements.name: xoshiro256.random
elements.description: When called without arguments, returns a uniform pseudo-random real number in the range [0,1). When called with an integer number m, returns a uniform pseudo-random integer in the range [1, m]. When called with two integer numbers m and n, returns a uniform pseudo-random integer in the range [m, n].

elements.name: xoshiro256.float_range
elements.description: Generates a random number in floating range [m, n)

elements.name: xoshiro256.clone
elements.description: Creates and returns an independent copy of the state

elements.name: xoshiro256.to_string
elements.description: Convert state to string. Used for saving the state. String is formed as 4 uint64 values separated by ':', e.g. "s0:s1:s2:s3".

elements.name: xoshiro256.from_string
elements.description: Convert previously saved string back to state.
